        }

    }

package com.acme.chat.scaffolding;

import com.dtronix.nexnet.CancellationToken;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;

/** One call of a client nexus method (or lifecycle slot) that a {@link ScriptHost} runs. */
public final class ScriptCall {
    /** The slot of {@code onConnected}; its argument is {@code [isReconnected]}. */
    public static final String ON_CONNECTED = "OnConnected";

    /** The slot of {@code onDisconnected}; it has no arguments. */
    public static final String ON_DISCONNECTED = "OnDisconnected";

    private final String slot;
    private final List<@Nullable Object> arguments;
    private final CancellationToken cancellationToken;
    private final @Nullable Object pipe;
    private final @Nullable TypedCodec<?> channelItem;

    /**
     * Creates a call.
     *
     * @param slot the slot: the C# method name, {@link #ON_CONNECTED} or {@link #ON_DISCONNECTED}
     * @param arguments the serialized arguments in wire order, typed JSON
     * @param cancellationToken the call's token; {@code CancellationToken.NONE} when the method takes none (the host
     *     then uses the client's lifetime)
     * @param pipe the {@code NexusDuplexPipe} or {@code NexusDuplexChannel} argument, or null
     * @param channelItem the codec of the channel's items, or null
     */
    public ScriptCall(String slot, List<@Nullable Object> arguments, CancellationToken cancellationToken,
                      @Nullable Object pipe, @Nullable TypedCodec<?> channelItem) {
        this.slot = slot;
        this.arguments = arguments;
        this.cancellationToken = cancellationToken;
        this.pipe = pipe;
        this.channelItem = channelItem;
    }

    /**
     * The slot.
     *
     * @return the slot name
     */
    public String slot() {
        return slot;
    }

    /**
     * The serialized arguments in wire order, typed JSON.
     *
     * @return the arguments
     */
    public List<@Nullable Object> arguments() {
        return arguments;
    }

    /**
     * The call's cancellation token.
     *
     * @return the token
     */
    public CancellationToken cancellationToken() {
        return cancellationToken;
    }

    /**
     * The {@code NexusDuplexPipe} or {@code NexusDuplexChannel} argument.
     *
     * @return the pipe or channel, or null
     */
    public @Nullable Object pipe() {
        return pipe;
    }

    /**
     * The codec of the channel's items.
     *
     * @return the codec, or null when the call has no channel
     */
    public @Nullable TypedCodec<?> channelItem() {
        return channelItem;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return slot + arguments;
    }

    /**
     * An argument list.
     *
     * @param values the typed-JSON values
     * @return the list
     */
    public static List<@Nullable Object> args(@Nullable Object... values) {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList(values));
    }

    /**
     * Hands a call to the host; a host that throws gives a failed future.
     *
     * @param host the host
     * @param slot the slot
     * @param arguments the typed-JSON arguments
     * @param cancellationToken the token
     * @param pipe the pipe or channel, or null
     * @param channelItem the channel item codec, or null
     * @return the host's future
     */
    public static CompletableFuture<@Nullable Object> run(ScriptHost host, String slot, List<@Nullable Object> arguments,
                                                          CancellationToken cancellationToken, @Nullable Object pipe,
                                                          @Nullable TypedCodec<?> channelItem) {
        try {
            return host.call(new ScriptCall(slot, arguments, cancellationToken, pipe, channelItem));
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            CompletableFuture<@Nullable Object> failed = new CompletableFuture<>();
            failed.completeExceptionally(e);
            return failed;
        }
    }
}

// <auto-generated/> Generated by the NexNet generator (Java target). Do not edit.
package com.acme.chat.scaffolding;

import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;

/**
 * The language host's side of a scriptable client nexus: it runs the script of each call (control protocol §6.6,
 * reference {@code ScriptInterpreter}): it reports the call ({@code script.call}), then runs the slot's steps.
 */
public interface ScriptHost {
    /**
     * Runs the script of one call of a slot.
     *
     * @param call the call: slot, typed-JSON arguments, cancellation, pipe or channel
     * @return a future of the typed-JSON result; null (or a call whose steps run out) is the .NET default result. A
     *     failed future fails the call. Ignored for fire-and-forget methods and lifecycle slots.
     */
    CompletableFuture<@Nullable Object> call(ScriptCall call);
}

package com.acme.chat.scaffolding;

import com.dtronix.nexnet.serialization.Formatter;
import com.dtronix.nexnet.serialization.Formatters;
import com.dtronix.nexnet.serialization.MsgPackOptions;
import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;

/**
 * Typed JSON of one Java type: the value goes through its generated formatter and {@link TypedJson}, so it has
 * exactly the wire form the C# side reads.
 *
 * @param <T> the Java type
 */
public final class TypedCodec<T> {
    private final String expression;
    private final Formatter<T> formatter;
    private final TypedJson.Type type;
    private final TypedJson.Schemas schemas;

    /**
     * Creates a codec.
     *
     * @param expression the golden type expression, declared types by full metadata name
     * @param formatter the formatter of the Java type
     * @param type the shape
     * @param schemas the declared types
     */
    public TypedCodec(String expression, Formatter<T> formatter, TypedJson.Type type, TypedJson.Schemas schemas) {
        this.expression = expression;
        this.formatter = formatter;
        this.type = type;
        this.schemas = schemas;
    }

    /**
     * The golden type expression ({@code int}, {@code List<string>}, {@code NexNet.TestNexus.Interop.InteropItem}),
     * as the runner names channel item types.
     *
     * @return the expression
     */
    public String expression() {
        return expression;
    }

    /**
     * The formatter, for {@code NexusClient.createChannel} and the like.
     *
     * @return the formatter
     */
    public Formatter<T> formatter() {
        return formatter;
    }

    /**
     * The shape.
     *
     * @return the shape
     */
    public TypedJson.Type type() {
        return type;
    }

    /**
     * The typed JSON of a value.
     *
     * @param value the value
     * @return the typed JSON
     */
    public @Nullable Object toJson(@Nullable T value) {
        return TypedJson.fromMsgPack(Formatters.serialize(formatter, value), type, schemas);
    }

    /**
     * The value of typed JSON; null is the .NET default (zero, an all-default struct, null).
     *
     * @param json the typed JSON
     * @return the value
     */
    public T fromJson(@Nullable Object json) {
        Object value = json == null ? TypedJson.defaultValue(type, schemas) : json;
        return Formatters.deserialize(formatter, TypedJson.toMsgPack(value, type, schemas), MsgPackOptions.TRUSTED);
    }

    /**
     * {@link #toJson} of a value whose static type is unknown (a channel item of a {@code TypedCodec<?>}).
     *
     * @param value the value, of this codec's type
     * @return the typed JSON
     */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public @Nullable Object toJsonUnchecked(@Nullable Object value) {
        return toJson((T) value);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return expression;
    }
}

/**
 * Converts between NexNet MessagePack values and typed JSON, the value model of the golden vectors and of the
 * interop control protocol ({@code tests/golden/README.md}, "Typed JSON"). The Java port of the C# {@code TypedJson}.
 *
 * <p>JSON values are plain Java objects: {@code null}, {@link Boolean}, {@link Number}, {@link String} and
 * {@link List} (JSON arrays). Output integers are {@link Long} within &#177;(2^53 - 1) and decimal strings beyond;
 * floats are bit-pattern strings ({@code "f32:0x3F800000"}). On input any integral {@link Number} or a decimal
 * string is an integer, and a plain number is accepted for a float.
 */
public final class TypedJson {
    /** Largest integer carried as a JSON number (2^53 - 1). */
    public static final long MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991L;

    private static final int PRIMITIVE_ARRAY_EXT = 78;
    private static final char[] HEX = "0123456789abcdef".toCharArray();
    private static final char[] BASE64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/".toCharArray();

    private TypedJson() {
    }

    /** The kind of a type shape (the IR {@code TypeRefKind}). */
    public enum Kind {
        /** A built-in leaf. */
        PRIM,
        /** MessagePack bin. */
        BIN,
        /** An ext 78 primitive array. */
        PRIM_ARRAY,
        /** An element-wise sequence. */
        SEQ,
        /** A set. */
        SET,
        /** A queue, front first. */
        QUEUE,
        /** A stack, top first. */
        STACK,
        /** A map. */
        MAP,
        /** A tuple or key-value pair. */
        TUPLE,
        /** A nullable value type. */
        NULLABLE,
        /** A declared type. */
        DECL,
        /** A type parameter of the enclosing declared type. */
        TYPE_PARAM,
        /** A type with a user formatter: its raw MessagePack value. */
        EXTERNAL,
    }

    /** The built-in leaf types (the IR {@code PrimKind}). */
    public enum Prim {
        /** {@code bool}. */
        BOOL,
        /** {@code sbyte}. */
        SBYTE,
        /** {@code byte}. */
        BYTE,
        /** {@code short}. */
        INT16,
        /** {@code ushort}. */
        UINT16,
        /** {@code int}. */
        INT32,
        /** {@code uint}. */
        UINT32,
        /** {@code long}. */
        INT64,
        /** {@code ulong}. */
        UINT64,
        /** {@code float}. */
        SINGLE,
        /** {@code double}. */
        DOUBLE,
        /** {@code Half}. */
        HALF,
        /** {@code char}. */
        CHAR,
        /** {@code decimal}. */
        DECIMAL,
        /** {@code string}. */
        STRING,
        /** {@code DateTime}. */
        DATE_TIME,
        /** {@code DateTimeOffset}. */
        DATE_TIME_OFFSET,
        /** {@code TimeSpan}. */
        TIME_SPAN,
        /** {@code DateOnly}. */
        DATE_ONLY,
        /** {@code TimeOnly}. */
        TIME_ONLY,
        /** {@code Guid}. */
        GUID,
        /** {@code BigInteger}. */
        BIG_INTEGER,
        /** {@code Uri}. */
        URI,
        /** {@code Version}. */
        VERSION,
    }

    /** The shape of a serialized type (the IR {@code TypeRef}). */
    public static final class Type {
        private final Kind kind;
        private final @Nullable Prim prim;
        private final @Nullable String clr;
        private final List<Type> args;
        private final @Nullable String declId;
        private final int ordinal;

        private Type(Kind kind, @Nullable Prim prim, @Nullable String clr, List<Type> args, @Nullable String declId, int ordinal) {
            this.kind = kind;
            this.prim = prim;
            this.clr = clr;
            this.args = Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(args));
            this.declId = declId;
            this.ordinal = ordinal;
        }

        /**
         * The kind.
         *
         * @return the kind
         */
        public Kind kind() {
            return kind;
        }

        /**
         * The leaf ({@link Kind#PRIM}) or element ({@link Kind#PRIM_ARRAY}).
         *
         * @return the primitive, or null
         */
        public @Nullable Prim prim() {
            return prim;
        }

        /**
         * The .NET container name ({@code List}, {@code Array}, {@code ValueTuple}…) or external type name.
         *
         * @return the name, or null
         */
        public @Nullable String clr() {
            return clr;
        }

        /**
         * Element, key/value, tuple element, nullable inner or type argument shapes.
         *
         * @return the arguments
         */
        public List<Type> args() {
            return args;
        }

        /**
         * The declared type id ({@link Kind#DECL}).
         *
         * @return the id, or null
         */
        public @Nullable String declId() {
            return declId;
        }

        /**
         * The type parameter position ({@link Kind#TYPE_PARAM}).
         *
         * @return the position
         */
        public int ordinal() {
            return ordinal;
        }

        /**
         * This shape with the type parameters replaced by {@code typeArgs}.
         *
         * @param typeArgs the type arguments
         * @return the bound shape
         */
        public Type bind(List<Type> typeArgs) {
            if (kind == Kind.TYPE_PARAM) {
                if (ordinal >= typeArgs.size()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unbound type parameter T" + ordinal + ".");
                }
                return typeArgs.get(ordinal);
            }
            if (args.isEmpty() || typeArgs.isEmpty()) {
                return this;
            }
            List<Type> bound = new ArrayList<>(args.size());
            for (Type arg : args) {
                bound.add(arg.bind(typeArgs));
            }
            return new Type(kind, prim, clr, bound, declId, ordinal);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return kind + (prim == null ? "" : " " + prim) + (clr == null ? "" : " " + clr)
                + (declId == null ? "" : " " + declId) + (args.isEmpty() ? "" : " " + args);
        }
    }

    /**
     * A built-in leaf.
     *
     * @param prim the leaf
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type prim(Prim prim) {
        return new Type(Kind.PRIM, prim, null, Collections.<Type>emptyList(), null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * Bytes written as bin.
     *
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type bin() {
        return new Type(Kind.BIN, null, null, Collections.<Type>emptyList(), null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * An ext 78 primitive array.
     *
     * @param element the element
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type primArray(Prim element) {
        return new Type(Kind.PRIM_ARRAY, element, null, Collections.<Type>emptyList(), null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * An element-wise sequence.
     *
     * @param clr the .NET container ({@code Array}, {@code List}, {@code IReadOnlyList}…), or null
     * @param element the element
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type seq(@Nullable String clr, Type element) {
        return new Type(Kind.SEQ, null, clr, Collections.singletonList(element), null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * A set.
     *
     * @param element the element
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type set(Type element) {
        return new Type(Kind.SET, null, null, Collections.singletonList(element), null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * A queue.
     *
     * @param element the element
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type queue(Type element) {
        return new Type(Kind.QUEUE, null, null, Collections.singletonList(element), null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * A stack.
     *
     * @param element the element
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type stack(Type element) {
        return new Type(Kind.STACK, null, null, Collections.singletonList(element), null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * A map.
     *
     * @param key the key
     * @param value the value
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type map(Type key, Type value) {
        return new Type(Kind.MAP, null, null, Arrays.asList(key, value), null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * A tuple.
     *
     * @param clr {@code ValueTuple}, {@code Tuple} or {@code KeyValuePair}
     * @param elements the elements
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type tuple(String clr, Type... elements) {
        return new Type(Kind.TUPLE, null, clr, Arrays.asList(elements), null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * A nullable value type.
     *
     * @param inner the value type
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type nullable(Type inner) {
        return new Type(Kind.NULLABLE, null, null, Collections.singletonList(inner), null, 0);
    }

    /**
     * A declared type.
     *
     * @param id the declared type id
     * @param typeArgs its type arguments
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type decl(String id, Type... typeArgs) {
        return new Type(Kind.DECL, null, null, Arrays.asList(typeArgs), id, 0);
    }

    /**
     * A type parameter of the enclosing declared type.
     *
     * @param ordinal its position
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type typeParam(int ordinal) {
        return new Type(Kind.TYPE_PARAM, null, null, Collections.<Type>emptyList(), null, ordinal);
    }

    /**
     * A type with a user formatter.
     *
     * @param clr the .NET type name
     * @return the shape
     */
    public static Type external(String clr) {
        return new Type(Kind.EXTERNAL, null, clr, Collections.<Type>emptyList(), null, 0);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ declared types

    /** A declared type: an object, a union or an enum. */
    public abstract static class Decl {
        private final String id;

        Decl(String id) {
            this.id = id;
        }

        /**
         * The id: the .NET full metadata name.
         *
         * @return the id
         */
        public String id() {
            return id;
        }
    }

    /** A {@code [NexusObject]} class or struct: an array by key, nil in the gaps. */
    public static final class ObjectDecl extends Decl {
        private final int length;
        private final boolean struct;
        private final @Nullable Type[] members;

        ObjectDecl(String id, int length, boolean struct, @Nullable Type[] members) {
            super(id);
            this.length = length;
            this.struct = struct;
            this.members = members;
        }

        /**
         * The array length.
         *
         * @return the length
         */
        public int length() {
            return length;
        }

        /**
         * True for a C# struct (nil is not a value of it).
         *
         * @return whether it is a struct
         */
        public boolean struct() {
            return struct;
        }

        /**
         * The member shape at {@code key}.
         *
         * @param key the key
         * @return the shape, or null for a gap
         */
        public @Nullable Type member(int key) {
            return key >= 0 && key < members.length ? members[key] : null;
        }
    }

    /** A union: {@code [tag, value]}. */
    public static final class UnionDecl extends Decl {
        private final Map<Integer, String> cases;

        UnionDecl(String id, Map<Integer, String> cases) {
            super(id);
            this.cases = cases;
        }

        /**
         * The declared type of a case.
         *
         * @param tag the tag
         * @return the case id, or null
         */
        public @Nullable String caseOf(int tag) {
            return cases.get(tag);
        }
    }

    /** An enum: its underlying integer. */
    public static final class EnumDecl extends Decl {
        private final Prim underlying;

        EnumDecl(String id, Prim underlying) {
            super(id);
            this.underlying = underlying;
        }

        /**
         * The underlying integer type.
         *
         * @return the primitive
         */
        public Prim underlying() {
            return underlying;
        }
    }

    /** One keyed member of an object. */
    public static final class Member {
        private final int key;
        private final Type type;

        Member(int key, Type type) {
            this.key = key;
            this.type = type;
        }
    }

    /**
     * A member of an object.
     *
     * @param key its key
     * @param type its shape
     * @return the member
     */
    public static Member member(int key, Type type) {
        return new Member(key, type);
    }

    /**
     * An object.
     *
     * @param id its id
     * @param length its array length
     * @param struct true for a C# struct
     * @param members its members, including those of its base types
     * @return the declaration
     */
    public static ObjectDecl object(String id, int length, boolean struct, Member... members) {
        @Nullable Type[] byKey = new Type[length];
        for (Member member : members) {
            if (member.key < 0 || member.key >= length) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Member key " + member.key + " is outside '" + id + "'.");
            }
            byKey[member.key] = member.type;
        }
        return new ObjectDecl(id, length, struct, byKey);
    }

    /**
     * A union.
     *
     * @param id its id
     * @param cases alternating tags and case ids: {@code 0, "Ns.Circle", 1, "Ns.Square"}
     * @return the declaration
     */
    public static UnionDecl union(String id, Object... cases) {
        Map<Integer, String> map = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < cases.length; i += 2) {
            map.put((Integer) cases[i], (String) cases[i + 1]);
        }
        return new UnionDecl(id, map);
    }

    /**
     * An enum.
     *
     * @param id its id
     * @param underlying its underlying integer type
     * @return the declaration
     */
    public static EnumDecl enumOf(String id, Prim underlying) {
        return new EnumDecl(id, underlying);
    }

    /** The declared types a shape may name. */
    public static final class Schemas {
        private final Map<String, Decl> byId = new HashMap<>();

        /**
         * Creates the set.
         *
         * @param decls the declarations
         */
        public Schemas(Decl... decls) {
            for (Decl decl : decls) {
                byId.put(decl.id(), decl);
            }
        }

        /**
         * The declaration of {@code id}.
         *
         * @param id the id
         * @return the declaration
         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when there is none
         */
        public Decl find(String id) {
            Decl decl = byId.get(id);
            if (decl == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown declared type '" + id + "'.");
            }
            return decl;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ entry points

    /**
     * Converts one MessagePack value to typed JSON.
     *
     * @param data the value's bytes
     * @param type its shape
     * @param schemas the declared types
     * @return the typed JSON
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the value does not match the shape
     */
    public static @Nullable Object fromMsgPack(byte[] data, Type type, Schemas schemas) {
        MsgPackReader reader = new MsgPackReader(data, 0, data.length, MsgPackOptions.TRUSTED);
        Object value = read(reader, type, schemas);
        if (!reader.isEnd()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Trailing bytes after the " + type + " value.");
        }
        return value;
    }

    /**
     * Converts typed JSON to one MessagePack value.
     *
     * @param value the typed JSON
     * @param type its shape
     * @param schemas the declared types
     * @return the bytes
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the value does not match the shape
     */
    public static byte[] toMsgPack(@Nullable Object value, Type type, Schemas schemas) {
        MsgPackWriter writer = new MsgPackWriter();
        write(writer, value, type, schemas);
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    /**
     * The typed JSON of the .NET default value of a shape: zero for numbers, enums and the other value types, the
     * defaults of every member for a struct, null for reference types.
     *
     * @param type the shape
     * @param schemas the declared types
     * @return the typed JSON
     */
    public static @Nullable Object defaultValue(Type type, Schemas schemas) {
        switch (type.kind()) {
            case PRIM:
                return defaultPrim(prim(type));
            case TUPLE:
                if (!"ValueTuple".equals(type.clr()) && !"KeyValuePair".equals(type.clr())) {
                    return null;
                }
                List<@Nullable Object> elements = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Type arg : type.args()) {
                    elements.add(defaultValue(arg, schemas));
                }
                return elements;
            case DECL: {
                Decl decl = schemas.find(declId(type));
                if (decl instanceof EnumDecl) {
                    return 0L;
                }
                if (decl instanceof ObjectDecl && ((ObjectDecl) decl).struct()) {
                    ObjectDecl obj = (ObjectDecl) decl;
                    List<@Nullable Object> members = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int key = 0; key < obj.length(); key++) {
                        Type member = obj.member(key);
                        members.add(member == null ? null : defaultValue(member.bind(type.args()), schemas));
                    }
                    return members;
                }
                return null;
            }
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    private static @Nullable Object defaultPrim(Prim prim) {
        switch (prim) {
            case BOOL:
                return Boolean.FALSE;
            case SINGLE:
                return "f32:0x00000000";
            case DOUBLE:
                return "f64:0x0000000000000000";
            case HALF:
                return "f16:0x0000";
            case DECIMAL:
                return Arrays.<Object>asList(0L, 0L, 0L, 0L);
            case DATE_TIME_OFFSET:
                return Arrays.<Object>asList(0L, 0L);
            case GUID:
                return "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000";
            case BIG_INTEGER:
                return "0";
            case STRING:
            case URI:
            case VERSION:
                return null;
            default:
                return 0L;
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ MessagePack -> JSON

    private static @Nullable Object read(MsgPackReader r, Type s, Schemas schemas) {
        if (s.kind() == Kind.TYPE_PARAM) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unbound type parameter T" + s.ordinal() + ".");
        }
        if (r.tryReadNil()) {
            return null;
        }

        switch (s.kind()) {
            case PRIM:
                return readPrim(r, prim(s));
            case BIN:
                return base64(r.readBinary());
            case PRIM_ARRAY:
                return readPrimArray(r, prim(s));
            case SEQ: {
                Kind wire = boundWireForm(s);
                if (wire == Kind.PRIM_ARRAY) {
                    return readPrimArray(r, prim(s.args().get(0)));
                }
                if (wire == Kind.BIN) {
                    byte[] bytes = r.readBinary();
                    return base64(bytes == null ? new byte[0] : bytes);
                }
                return readArray(r, arg(s, 0), schemas);
            }
            case SET:
            case QUEUE:
            case STACK:
                return readArray(r, arg(s, 0), schemas);
            case MAP: {
                int count = r.readMapHeader();
                List<@Nullable Object> array = new ArrayList<>(count);
                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    Object key = read(r, arg(s, 0), schemas);
                    Object value = read(r, arg(s, 1), schemas);
                    array.add(Arrays.asList(key, value));
                }
                return array;
            }
            case TUPLE: {
                int count = r.readArrayHeader();
                List<@Nullable Object> array = new ArrayList<>(count);
                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    if (i < s.args().size()) {
                        array.add(read(r, s.args().get(i), schemas));
                    } else {
                        r.skip();
                        array.add(null);
                    }
                }
                return array;
            }
            case NULLABLE:
                return read(r, arg(s, 0), schemas);
            case DECL:
                return readDecl(r, schemas.find(declId(s)), s.args(), schemas);
            case EXTERNAL:
                return base64(r.readRawValue());
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape kind " + s.kind() + ".");
        }
    }

    private static List<@Nullable Object> readArray(MsgPackReader r, Type element, Schemas schemas) {
        int count = r.readArrayHeader();
        List<@Nullable Object> array = new ArrayList<>(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            array.add(read(r, element, schemas));
        }
        return array;
    }

    private static @Nullable Object readDecl(MsgPackReader r, Decl decl, List<Type> typeArgs, Schemas schemas) {
        if (decl instanceof ObjectDecl) {
            ObjectDecl obj = (ObjectDecl) decl;
            int count = r.readArrayHeader();
            List<@Nullable Object> array = new ArrayList<>(count);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                Type member = obj.member(i);
                if (member != null) {
                    array.add(read(r, member.bind(typeArgs), schemas));
                } else {
                    r.skip();
                    array.add(null);
                }
            }
            return array;
        }
        if (decl instanceof UnionDecl) {
            UnionDecl union = (UnionDecl) decl;
            r.readArrayHeader(2);
            int tag = r.readUInt16();
            String caseId = union.caseOf(tag);
            if (caseId == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Union '" + union.id() + "' has no case " + tag + ".");
            }
            Object value = read(r, new Type(Kind.DECL, null, null, typeArgs, caseId, 0), schemas);
            return Arrays.<@Nullable Object>asList((long) tag, value);
        }
        return readPrim(r, ((EnumDecl) decl).underlying());
    }

    private static Object readPrim(MsgPackReader r, Prim prim) {
        switch (prim) {
            case BOOL:
                return r.readBoolean();
            case SBYTE:
            case BYTE:
            case INT16:
            case UINT16:
            case INT32:
            case UINT32:
            case INT64:
            case DATE_TIME:
            case TIME_SPAN:
            case TIME_ONLY:
                return integer(r.readLong());
            case CHAR:
                return (long) r.readUInt16();
            case DATE_ONLY:
                return integer(r.readInt());
            case UINT64:
                return unsigned(r.readUInt64());
            case SINGLE:
                return single(r.readFloat());
            case DOUBLE:
                return doubleBits(r.readDouble());
            case HALF:
                return half(Float16.fromFloat(r.readFloat()));
            case STRING:
            case URI:
            case VERSION:
                return r.readString();
            case DATE_TIME_OFFSET: {
                r.readArrayHeader(2);
                long utcTicks = r.readLong();
                long offsetMinutes = r.readShort();
                return Arrays.<Object>asList(integer(utcTicks), offsetMinutes);
            }
            case DECIMAL: {
                byte[] bytes = readFixedBinary(r, 16, "decimal");
                List<Object> parts = new ArrayList<>(4);
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    parts.add((long) readInt32Le(bytes, i * 4));
                }
                return parts;
            }
            case GUID:
                return guid(readFixedBinary(r, 16, "Guid"));
            case BIG_INTEGER: {
                int length = r.readBinaryHeader();
                byte[] bytes = r.readRaw(length);
                return bytes.length == 0 ? "0" : new BigInteger(reverse(bytes)).toString();
            }
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown primitive " + prim + ".");
        }
    }

    private static byte[] readFixedBinary(MsgPackReader r, int length, String what) {
        int actual = r.readBinaryHeader();
        if (actual != length) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(what + " must be " + length + " bytes.");
        }
        return r.readRaw(length);
    }

    private static List<Object> readPrimArray(MsgPackReader r, Prim element) {
        int length = r.readExtHeader();
        if (r.lastExtType() != PRIMITIVE_ARRAY_EXT) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected ext " + PRIMITIVE_ARRAY_EXT + ", got ext " + r.lastExtType() + ".");
        }
        if (length < 1) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Primitive array without a kind byte.");
        }
        byte[] bytes = r.readRaw(length);
        if ((bytes[0] & 0xFF) != primitiveKind(element)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Primitive array kind " + (bytes[0] & 0xFF) + " does not match " + element + ".");
        }
        int size = elementSize(element);
        if ((length - 1) % size != 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Primitive array length is not a multiple of the element size.");
        }
        List<Object> array = new ArrayList<>((length - 1) / size);
        for (int offset = 1; offset < length; offset += size) {
            array.add(readElement(element, bytes, offset));
        }
        return array;
    }

    private static Object readElement(Prim element, byte[] b, int offset) {
        switch (element) {
            case SBYTE:
                return (long) b[offset];
            case INT16:
                return (long) (short) readUInt16Le(b, offset);
            case UINT16:
            case CHAR:
                return (long) readUInt16Le(b, offset);
            case INT32:
                return (long) readInt32Le(b, offset);
            case UINT32:
                return readInt32Le(b, offset) & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
            case INT64:
                return integer(readInt64Le(b, offset));
            case UINT64:
                return unsigned(readInt64Le(b, offset));
            case SINGLE:
                return single(Float.intBitsToFloat(readInt32Le(b, offset)));
            case DOUBLE:
                return doubleBits(Double.longBitsToDouble(readInt64Le(b, offset)));
            case HALF:
                return half((short) readUInt16Le(b, offset));
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(element + " is not a primitive array element.");
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ JSON -> MessagePack

    private static void write(MsgPackWriter w, @Nullable Object v, Type s, Schemas schemas) {
        if (s.kind() == Kind.TYPE_PARAM) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unbound type parameter T" + s.ordinal() + ".");
        }
        if (v == null) {
            w.writeNil();
            return;
        }

        switch (s.kind()) {
            case PRIM:
                writePrim(w, v, prim(s));
                break;
            case BIN:
                w.writeBinary(fromBase64(string(v)));
                break;
            case PRIM_ARRAY:
                writePrimArray(w, array(v), prim(s));
                break;
            case SEQ: {
                Kind wire = boundWireForm(s);
                if (wire == Kind.PRIM_ARRAY) {
                    writePrimArray(w, array(v), prim(s.args().get(0)));
                } else if (wire == Kind.BIN) {
                    w.writeBinary(fromBase64(string(v)));
                } else {
                    writeArray(w, array(v), arg(s, 0), schemas);
                }
                break;
            }
            case SET:
            case QUEUE:
            case STACK:
                writeArray(w, array(v), arg(s, 0), schemas);
                break;
            case MAP: {
                List<?> entries = array(v);
                w.writeMapHeader(entries.size());
                for (Object entry : entries) {
                    List<?> pair = array(entry);
                    if (pair.size() != 2) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("A map entry must be [key, value].");
                    }
                    write(w, pair.get(0), arg(s, 0), schemas);
                    write(w, pair.get(1), arg(s, 1), schemas);
                }
                break;
            }
            case TUPLE: {
                List<?> elements = array(v);
                if (elements.size() != s.args().size()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("A tuple of " + s.args().size() + " needs " + s.args().size() + " elements.");
                }
                w.writeArrayHeader(elements.size());
                for (int i = 0; i < elements.size(); i++) {
                    write(w, elements.get(i), s.args().get(i), schemas);
                }
                break;
            }
            case NULLABLE:
                write(w, v, arg(s, 0), schemas);
                break;
            case DECL:
                writeDecl(w, v, schemas.find(declId(s)), s.args(), schemas);
                break;
            case EXTERNAL:
                w.writeRaw(fromBase64(string(v)));
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown shape kind " + s.kind() + ".");
        }
    }

    private static void writeArray(MsgPackWriter w, List<?> items, Type element, Schemas schemas) {
        w.writeArrayHeader(items.size());
        for (Object item : items) {
            write(w, item, element, schemas);
        }
    }

    private static void writeDecl(MsgPackWriter w, Object v, Decl decl, List<Type> typeArgs, Schemas schemas) {
        if (decl instanceof ObjectDecl) {
            ObjectDecl obj = (ObjectDecl) decl;
            List<?> members = array(v);
            w.writeArrayHeader(members.size());
            for (int i = 0; i < members.size(); i++) {
                Type member = obj.member(i);
                if (member != null) {
                    write(w, members.get(i), member.bind(typeArgs), schemas);
                } else if (members.get(i) == null) {
                    w.writeNil();
                } else {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("'" + obj.id() + "' has no member with key " + i + ".");
                }
            }
        } else if (decl instanceof UnionDecl) {
            UnionDecl union = (UnionDecl) decl;
            List<?> pair = array(v);
            if (pair.size() != 2) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("A union value must be [tag, value].");
            }
            long tag = parseInt64(pair.get(0));
            String caseId = tag < 0 || tag > 0xFFFF ? null : union.caseOf((int) tag);
            if (caseId == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Union '" + union.id() + "' has no case " + tag + ".");
            }
            w.writeArrayHeader(2);
            w.writeInt(tag);
            write(w, pair.get(1), new Type(Kind.DECL, null, null, typeArgs, caseId, 0), schemas);
        } else {
            writePrim(w, v, ((EnumDecl) decl).underlying());
        }
    }

    private static void writePrim(MsgPackWriter w, Object v, Prim prim) {
        switch (prim) {
            case BOOL:
                if (!(v instanceof Boolean)) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected a JSON boolean, got " + v + ".");
                }
                w.writeBoolean((Boolean) v);
                break;
            case SBYTE:
                w.writeInt(checkedRange(v, -128, 127));
                break;
            case BYTE:
                w.writeInt(checkedRange(v, 0, 255));
                break;
            case INT16:
                w.writeInt(checkedRange(v, Short.MIN_VALUE, Short.MAX_VALUE));
                break;
            case UINT16:
            case CHAR:
                w.writeInt(checkedRange(v, 0, 65535));
                break;
            case INT32:
            case DATE_ONLY:
                w.writeInt(checkedRange(v, Integer.MIN_VALUE, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
                break;
            case UINT32:
                w.writeInt(checkedRange(v, 0, 4294967295L));
                break;
            case INT64:
            case DATE_TIME:
            case TIME_SPAN:
            case TIME_ONLY:
                w.writeInt(parseInt64(v));
                break;
            case UINT64:
                w.writeUInt64(parseUInt64(v));
                break;
            case SINGLE:
                w.writeFloat(parseSingle(v));
                break;
            case DOUBLE:
                w.writeDouble(parseDouble(v));
                break;
            case HALF:
                w.writeFloat(Float16.toFloat(parseHalf(v)));
                break;
            case STRING:
            case URI:
            case VERSION:
                w.writeString(string(v));
                break;
            case DATE_TIME_OFFSET: {
                List<?> pair = array(v);
                if (pair.size() != 2) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("A DateTimeOffset must be [utcTicks, offsetMinutes].");
                }
                w.writeArrayHeader(2);
                w.writeInt(parseInt64(pair.get(0)));
                w.writeInt(checkedRange(pair.get(1), Short.MIN_VALUE, Short.MAX_VALUE));
                break;
            }
            case DECIMAL: {
                List<?> parts = array(v);
                if (parts.size() != 4) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("A decimal must be [lo, mid, hi, flags].");
                }
                byte[] bytes = new byte[16];
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    writeInt32Le(bytes, i * 4, (int) checkedRange(parts.get(i), Integer.MIN_VALUE, 4294967295L));
                }
                w.writeBinary(bytes);
                break;
            }
            case GUID:
                w.writeBinary(parseGuid(string(v)));
                break;
            case BIG_INTEGER:
                w.writeBinary(reverse(new BigInteger(string(v)).toByteArray()));
                break;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown primitive " + prim + ".");
        }
    }

    private static void writePrimArray(MsgPackWriter w, List<?> items, Prim element) {
        int size = elementSize(element);
        byte[] bytes = new byte[1 + items.size() * size];
        bytes[0] = (byte) primitiveKind(element);
        for (int i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) {
            Object item = items.get(i);
            if (item == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("A primitive array cannot hold null.");
            }
            int offset = 1 + i * size;
            switch (element) {
                case SBYTE:
                    bytes[offset] = (byte) checkedRange(item, -128, 127);
                    break;
                case INT16:
                    writeUInt16Le(bytes, offset, (int) checkedRange(item, Short.MIN_VALUE, Short.MAX_VALUE));
                    break;
                case UINT16:
                case CHAR:
                    writeUInt16Le(bytes, offset, (int) checkedRange(item, 0, 65535));
                    break;
                case INT32:
                    writeInt32Le(bytes, offset, (int) checkedRange(item, Integer.MIN_VALUE, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
                    break;
                case UINT32:
                    writeInt32Le(bytes, offset, (int) checkedRange(item, 0, 4294967295L));
                    break;
                case INT64:
                    writeInt64Le(bytes, offset, parseInt64(item));
                    break;
                case UINT64:
                    writeInt64Le(bytes, offset, parseUInt64(item));
                    break;
                case SINGLE:
                    writeInt32Le(bytes, offset, Float.floatToRawIntBits(parseSingle(item)));
                    break;
                case DOUBLE:
                    writeInt64Le(bytes, offset, Double.doubleToRawLongBits(parseDouble(item)));
                    break;
                case HALF:
                    writeUInt16Le(bytes, offset, parseHalf(item) & 0xFFFF);
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(element + " is not a primitive array element.");
            }
        }
        w.writeExtHeader(PRIMITIVE_ARRAY_EXT, bytes.length);
        w.writeRaw(bytes);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    /**
     * The wire form of a sequence: a generic {@code T[]}/{@code List<T>}/{@code Memory<T>} bound to a primitive is an
     * ext 78 primitive array (bin for bytes), as the C# formatter of the closed type writes it.
     */
    private static Kind boundWireForm(Type seq) {
        if (seq.args().size() != 1 || seq.args().get(0).kind() != Kind.PRIM) {
            return Kind.SEQ;
        }
        Prim element = prim(seq.args().get(0));
        String clr = seq.clr();
        if ("Array".equals(clr) || "Memory".equals(clr) || "ReadOnlyMemory".equals(clr)) {
            if (element == Prim.BYTE) {
                return Kind.BIN;
            }
            return isExtElement(element) ? Kind.PRIM_ARRAY : Kind.SEQ;
        }
        if ("List".equals(clr)) {
            return isExtElement(element) ? Kind.PRIM_ARRAY : Kind.SEQ;
        }
        return Kind.SEQ;
    }

    private static boolean isExtElement(Prim element) {
        switch (element) {
            case SBYTE:
            case INT16:
            case UINT16:
            case INT32:
            case UINT32:
            case INT64:
            case UINT64:
            case SINGLE:
            case DOUBLE:
            case CHAR:
            case HALF:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    private static int primitiveKind(Prim element) {
        switch (element) {
            case SBYTE:
                return 1;
            case INT16:
                return 2;
            case UINT16:
                return 3;
            case INT32:
                return 4;
            case UINT32:
                return 5;
            case INT64:
                return 6;
            case UINT64:
                return 7;
            case SINGLE:
                return 8;
            case DOUBLE:
                return 9;
            case CHAR:
                return 10;
            case HALF:
                return 11;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(element + " is not a primitive array element.");
        }
    }

    private static int elementSize(Prim element) {
        switch (element) {
            case SBYTE:
                return 1;
            case INT16:
            case UINT16:
            case CHAR:
            case HALF:
                return 2;
            case INT32:
            case UINT32:
            case SINGLE:
                return 4;
            case INT64:
            case UINT64:
            case DOUBLE:
                return 8;
            default:
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(element + " is not a primitive array element.");
        }
    }

    private static Prim prim(Type type) {
        Prim prim = type.prim();
        if (prim == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("The shape " + type + " has no primitive.");
        }
        return prim;
    }

    private static String declId(Type type) {
        String id = type.declId();
        if (id == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("The shape " + type + " has no declared type.");
        }
        return id;
    }

    private static Type arg(Type s, int index) {
        if (index >= s.args().size()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(s.kind() + " shape is missing argument " + index + ".");
        }
        return s.args().get(index);
    }

    private static List<?> array(@Nullable Object v) {
        if (v instanceof List) {
            return (List<?>) v;
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected a JSON array, got " + v + ".");
    }

    private static String string(@Nullable Object v) {
        if (v instanceof String) {
            return (String) v;
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected a JSON string, got " + v + ".");
    }

    /**
     * A JSON integer: a number within &#177;(2^53 - 1), otherwise a decimal string.
     *
     * @param value the value
     * @return the JSON value
     */
    public static Object integer(long value) {
        if (value >= -MAX_SAFE_INTEGER && value <= MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) {
            return value;
        }
        return Long.toString(value);
    }

    private static Object unsigned(long bits) {
        if (bits >= 0 && bits <= MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) {
            return bits;
        }
        return unsignedString(bits);
    }

    private static String unsignedString(long bits) {
        if (bits >= 0) {
            return Long.toString(bits);
        }
        return BigInteger.valueOf(bits).add(BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(64)).toString();
    }

    private static String single(float value) {
        return "f32:0x" + hexUpper(Float.floatToRawIntBits(value) & 0xFFFFFFFFL, 8);
    }

    private static String doubleBits(double value) {
        return "f64:0x" + hexUpper(Double.doubleToRawLongBits(value), 16);
    }

    private static String half(short bits) {
        return "f16:0x" + hexUpper(bits & 0xFFFFL, 4);
    }

    private static String hexUpper(long bits, int digits) {
        char[] chars = new char[digits];
        for (int i = digits - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            chars[i] = Character.toUpperCase(HEX[(int) (bits & 0xF)]);
            bits >>>= 4;
        }
        return new String(chars);
    }

    private static BigInteger integerValue(@Nullable Object v) {
        if (v instanceof Long || v instanceof Integer || v instanceof Short || v instanceof Byte) {
            return BigInteger.valueOf(((Number) v).longValue());
        }
        if (v instanceof BigInteger) {
            return (BigInteger) v;
        }
        if (v instanceof BigDecimal) {
            return ((BigDecimal) v).toBigIntegerExact();
        }
        if (v instanceof Double || v instanceof Float) {
            double d = ((Number) v).doubleValue();
            if (d != Math.rint(d) || Double.isInfinite(d)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected an integer, got " + v + ".");
            }
            return new BigDecimal(d).toBigIntegerExact();
        }
        if (v instanceof String) {
            return new BigInteger((String) v);
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected an integer, got " + v + ".");
    }

    private static long checkedRange(@Nullable Object v, long min, long max) {
        BigInteger value = integerValue(v);
        if (value.compareTo(BigInteger.valueOf(min)) < 0 || value.compareTo(BigInteger.valueOf(max)) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(value + " is outside [" + min + ", " + max + "].");
        }
        return value.longValue();
    }

    private static long parseInt64(@Nullable Object v) {
        return checkedRange(v, Long.MIN_VALUE, Long.MAX_VALUE);
    }

    private static long parseUInt64(@Nullable Object v) {
        BigInteger value = integerValue(v);
        if (value.signum() < 0 || value.bitLength() > 64) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(value + " is outside the ulong range.");
        }
        return value.longValue();
    }

    private static @Nullable Long bits(Object v, String prefix) {
        if (!(v instanceof String) || !((String) v).startsWith(prefix)) {
            return null;
        }
        return new BigInteger(((String) v).substring(prefix.length()), 16).longValue();
    }

    private static double number(Object v) {
        if (v instanceof Number) {
            return ((Number) v).doubleValue();
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected a float bit pattern or a number, got " + v + ".");
    }

    private static double parseDouble(Object v) {
        Long b = bits(v, "f64:0x");
        if (b != null) {
            return Double.longBitsToDouble(b);
        }
        b = bits(v, "f32:0x");
        if (b != null) {
            return Float.intBitsToFloat(b.intValue());
        }
        b = bits(v, "f16:0x");
        if (b != null) {
            return Float16.toFloat(b.shortValue());
        }
        return number(v);
    }

    private static float parseSingle(Object v) {
        Long b = bits(v, "f32:0x");
        if (b != null) {
            return Float.intBitsToFloat(b.intValue());
        }
        b = bits(v, "f16:0x");
        if (b != null) {
            return Float16.toFloat(b.shortValue());
        }
        return (float) parseDouble(v);
    }

    private static short parseHalf(Object v) {
        Long b = bits(v, "f16:0x");
        return b != null ? b.shortValue() : Float16.fromFloat(parseSingle(v));
    }

    private static String guid(byte[] b) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(36);
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            if (i == 4 || i == 6 || i == 8 || i == 10) {
                sb.append('-');
            }
            sb.append(HEX[(b[i] >> 4) & 0xF]).append(HEX[b[i] & 0xF]);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static byte[] parseGuid(String text) {
        String hex = text.replace("-", "");
        if (hex.length() != 32) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("'" + text + "' is not a Guid.");
        }
        byte[] bytes = new byte[16];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            bytes[i] = (byte) Integer.parseInt(hex.substring(2 * i, 2 * i + 2), 16);
        }
        return bytes;
    }

    private static byte[] reverse(byte[] bytes) {
        byte[] result = new byte[bytes.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
            result[i] = bytes[bytes.length - 1 - i];
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static int readUInt16Le(byte[] b, int offset) {
        return (b[offset] & 0xFF) | ((b[offset + 1] & 0xFF) << 8);
    }

    private static int readInt32Le(byte[] b, int offset) {
        return (b[offset] & 0xFF) | ((b[offset + 1] & 0xFF) << 8) | ((b[offset + 2] & 0xFF) << 16) | ((b[offset + 3] & 0xFF) << 24);
    }

    private static long readInt64Le(byte[] b, int offset) {
        return (readInt32Le(b, offset) & 0xFFFFFFFFL) | ((long) readInt32Le(b, offset + 4) << 32);
    }

    private static void writeUInt16Le(byte[] b, int offset, int value) {
        b[offset] = (byte) value;
        b[offset + 1] = (byte) (value >>> 8);
    }

    private static void writeInt32Le(byte[] b, int offset, int value) {
        b[offset] = (byte) value;
        b[offset + 1] = (byte) (value >>> 8);
        b[offset + 2] = (byte) (value >>> 16);
        b[offset + 3] = (byte) (value >>> 24);
    }

    private static void writeInt64Le(byte[] b, int offset, long value) {
        writeInt32Le(b, offset, (int) value);
        writeInt32Le(b, offset + 4, (int) (value >>> 32));
    }

    /**
     * Base64 (RFC 4648, padded) of bytes. {@code java.util.Base64} needs Android API 26.
     *
     * @param bytes the bytes, or null
     * @return the text, or null
     */
    public static @Nullable String base64(byte @Nullable [] bytes) {
        if (bytes == null) {
            return null;
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder((bytes.length + 2) / 3 * 4);
        for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
            int b0 = bytes[i] & 0xFF;
            int b1 = i + 1 < bytes.length ? bytes[i + 1] & 0xFF : 0;
            int b2 = i + 2 < bytes.length ? bytes[i + 2] & 0xFF : 0;
            sb.append(BASE64[b0 >> 2]).append(BASE64[((b0 & 3) << 4) | (b1 >> 4)]);
            sb.append(i + 1 < bytes.length ? BASE64[((b1 & 15) << 2) | (b2 >> 6)] : '=');
            sb.append(i + 2 < bytes.length ? BASE64[b2 & 63] : '=');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /**
     * The bytes of base64 text (RFC 4648, padded).
     *
     * @param text the text
     * @return the bytes
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the text is not base64
     */
    public static byte[] fromBase64(String text) {
        if (text.length() % 4 != 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid base64 length " + text.length() + ".");
        }
        int padding = text.endsWith("==") ? 2 : text.endsWith("=") ? 1 : 0;
        byte[] result = new byte[text.length() / 4 * 3 - padding];
        int out = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i += 4) {
            int n = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                char c = text.charAt(i + j);
                int d = c == '=' && i + 4 == text.length() && j >= 4 - padding ? 0 : base64Digit(c);
                n = (n << 6) | d;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 3 && out < result.length; j++) {
                result[out++] = (byte) (n >> (16 - 8 * j));
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static int base64Digit(char c) {
        if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') {
            return c - 'A';
        }
        if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') {
            return c - 'a' + 26;
        }
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            return c - '0' + 52;
        }
        if (c == '+') {
            return 62;
        }
        if (c == '/') {
            return 63;
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid base64 character '" + c + "'.");
    }
}
